positive_terms: Description of approach to ensuring that processes to provide or enable remedy in event of material negative impacts on affected communities are available and effective in their implementation and outcomes
确保社区补救流程可用有效的机制
描述主体如何确保在受影响社区发生重大负面影响时，补救流程可得、可实施且结果有效。须说明适用主体、期间与报告边界；泛泛表述不能替代。
